scope: House Tang and Sword Manor armory strategic-stock rebaseline
retirement of obsolete trainee heavy-lamellar, lamellar-helmet and medium-shield House inventory/production
House Tang garrison war-arrow reserve expansion
campaign-scale Tang Wei field-service departure policy

population_basis.rule: No bodies are created or removed by this equipment/logistics rebaseline.

retired_inventory_rule: These obsolete trainee equipment lines are removed from House Tang/Sword Manor current campaign truth by explicit OOC rebaseline, not sold, salvaged, destroyed, or converted through an in-world transaction. Generic item definitions remain available to other world actors.
armory_rebaseline_rule: Issued equipment is not multiplied into extra soldiers. Aggregate issued counts are aligned to the current 60,000-man House Tang plus Sword Manor fighting establishments; strategic unissued reserves are massively expanded, and missing prior reserve ledgers for long spear, cavalry lance and one-handed long sword are established explicitly.
treasury_effect: none; explicit OOC campaign rebaseline rather than in-world procurement
